_comment: Portable chemical Langevin (SDE) golden. Generated by go-pflow stochastic.SimulateSDE (portable path) at commit d84dc017bfe42acd03176b74a7bb91878d72d5f1-dirty; never regenerate to make a test pass. Model is byte-identical to the same-named fixture in stochastic/testdata/portable/ (cmd/ssa-goldens); a 'diverged' fixture records SimulateSDE's own refusal rather than fabricating a series it never produced.
reason: this model constrains firing in ways continuous diffusion cannot express, so the SDE would silently model an unconstrained system. Use the discrete engine (Simulate). Specifically: 1 read arc(s) gate a firing without consuming; a continuous solver cannot test them; 1 inhibitor arc(s) block a firing above a threshold; a continuous solver cannot test them; 1 non-kinetic input arc(s) gate and consume without scaling the rate; a mass-action solver has no way to omit them from the rate law; capacity is declared on [buf] but is a post-firing bound, which has no continuous analogue
caveats: 1 read arc(s) gate a firing without consuming; a continuous solver cannot test them
